### Hemoglobin (Hb)

**What it is:** Iron-rich protein in red blood cells that transports oxygen from lungs to vital organs.

**Standard Reference Range:** 13.5 - 17.5 g/dL

**Clinical Implication:** Low levels indicate anemia, causing reduced tissue oxygenation, fatigue, and weakness.

**Dietary Recommendation:** Consume iron-rich foods (spinach, beans, lentils, lean meats) paired with Vitamin C to boost absorption.

**Lifestyle Advice:** Avoid strenuous exhaustion; ensure adequate restorative sleep.

**Specialist to Consult:** Hematologist or General Physician
